name: dsfd_mtp_seq_m5-m5-COMMIT
purpose: M5 re-route (reroute_batch.py) of closed mtp-mtp_seq-c-c67a71fe5-tc (dsfd_mtp_seq, RTL c67a71fe5, snapshot of 7 drifted files): same RTL, outline 151.2x151.2, pin faces from the closed view; ref_tile layer cap M5 (signals + PG <= M5, pins M4/M5, parent strap M6). Orig owner Claude:mtp-rom

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; dsfd_mtp_seq u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv physical/ref_tile/dsfd_mtp_seq_m5/src/rtl/dsrom_sys/mtp/dsfd_mtp_tops.sv physical/ref_tile/dsfd_mtp_seq_m5/src/rtl/dsrom_sys/mtp/ot_dsrom_mtp_link_pair.sv physical/ref_tile/dsfd_mtp_seq_m5/src/rtl/dsrom_sys/mtp/ot_dsrom_mtp_skid.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/mtp/ot_dsrom_mtp_seq.sv physical/ref_tile/dsfd_mtp_seq_m5/src/rtl/dsrom_sys/mtp/ot_dsrom_wfc_tok.sv physical/ref_tile/dsfd_mtp_seq_m5/src/rtl/dsrom_sys/mtp/ot_dsrom_wfc_lnk.sv physical/ref_tile/dsfd_mtp_seq_m5/src/rtl/dsrom_sys/mtp/ot_dsrom_wfc_vmx.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/mtp/ot_dsrom_drf_fan.sv rtl/common/ot_ratio_cdc_fifo.sv && echo lint-ok

bench.name: pass_s0_tr_forced
bench.cmd:
B={RUN}/bsrc_m5_0; rm -rf $B && mkdir -p $B && for d in *; do ln -s $PWD/$d $B/$d; done && for d in $(cd physical/ref_tile/dsfd_mtp_seq_m5/src && ls -d */ | tr -d /); do rm -f $B/$d; cp -a $PWD/$d $B/$d; done && cp -a physical/ref_tile/dsfd_mtp_seq_m5/src/. $B/ && cd $B && { python3 tools/dsrom_mtp_rom_bench.py one s0_tr_forced --out {RUN}/bench
}
bench.note: [m5rr: run on the c67a71fe5 snapshot overlay of physical/ref_tile/dsfd_mtp_seq_m5/src]

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.01 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/dsfd_mtp_seq_m5/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/dsfd_mtp_seq_m5/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/dsfd_mtp_seq_m5 --out {RUN}/record/views/dsfd_mtp_seq  > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1
